paite: Huchi in David in, "Hiai zaw TOUPA Pathian inn ahi hi; hiai zaw Israelte halmang thillatna maitam ahi hi," achi hi.
heading: Tempul Lam Ding A Kisakkholhna

paite: Huchi in David in Israel gam a namdang omte sapkhawm thu apia a; huan, Pathian inn lamna ding in suangsek mite suang aseksak hi.
David in intual kongkhak leh abulhna ding kilhna ding sik tampi abawlkhol a; dal tamtak buk seng louh toh; sidar sing sim seng louh toh;
Zidon mi leh Tura mite'n David kiang ah sidar sing tampi ahon la uhi.

David in, "Ka tapa Solomon lah anaupang lai in, bangmah athei nai kei a, TOUPA' inn lam ding thupitak, amin leh athupina gam chih a thangkhe ding ahi a; huaiziak in ka kisakhol hi," achi hi. Huchi in David asih ma in akisakhol nasa mahmah hi.
heading: Tempul Lam Ding In David In Solomon Thu Apia

paite: Huchi in atapa Solomon asam a, TOUPA Israel' Pathian inn lam ding in thu apia hi.
Huan David in atapa Solomon kiang ah, "TOUPA ka Pathian min ding in inn lam lungsim in ka nei gige hi.
Himahleh, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, nang zaw sisan na naksuah tel a, kidoute na uang tel a; leitung ah ka mitmuh a sisan na naksuah ziak in, ka min a ding in inn na lam kei ding.

Ngai in, tapa chingkam na hon nei ding a, amah kei lungtuak mi ahi ding a, akim gam a amelma tengteng lak ah galmuanna ka pe ding; amin Solomon ahi ding a, amah ziak in Israelte galmuang leh lungmuangtak in ka omsak ding.
Ama'n ka min a ding in inn alam ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding a, kei apa ka hi ding; huan, Israelte tung a agam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding.
"Huchi in ka tapa, TOUPA na kiang ah om henla, lamzang zel inla, na tungtang thu agenkholhsa bang in, TOUPA na Pathian inn lam in.
TOUPA'N pilna leh theihnate hon neisak peuhmah phot henla, Israelte tung ah thuneihna hon pia hen, huchi in TOUPA na Pathian dan na zui thei ding hi.
Huchi in Israelte tungtang thu a dan thusehte leh vaihawmnate TOUPA'N Mosi apiak na zuihleh, na lamzang zel ding; hattak in om inla, hangsantak in om in; lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n.

Ngai in, ka lungzin lai in TOUPA' inn a ding in dangka-eng talent nuaikhat leh dangkasik talent maktaduaikhat ka na kisakhol khin a; dal leh sikte leng buk seng louh, tampi ahi; sing leh suang leng ka kisakhol khin ahi, huaite na sunzom theita ding.
Nasemmi, sing-atmi leh suangsekmi leh khutsiamna chiteng sem thei leng na hau hi.
Sim seng vual louh dangka-engte, dangkate, dalte, sikte leng; thou inla, nasep pan in, TOUPA na kiang ah om hen," achi hi.
David in Israelte makai tengteng atapa Solomon panpih ding in thu apia hi.
"TOUPA na Pathian uh na kiang uah a-om kei a hia? Mun chih mual chih ah galmuanna ahon pe kei a hia? Hiai gam a mite ka khut ah ahon peta a, TOUPA ma leh amite ma ah gam lak ahita.

Tu in na lungtang uleh na lungsim uh TOUPA na Pathian uh zong ding in koihkip un; huaiziak in thou unla, TOUPA min a inn lam ding suang, TOUPA thukhun bawm leh Pathian tui-um belsuan siangthoute laklutna ding in, mun siangthou lam un," achi hi.
